data.title: Attackers hijack about 64,000 Bitcoin miners and point 13 EH/s at OCEAN
data.description: Someone took control of approximately 64,000 Bitcoin mining machines on November 14, 2026. They redirected roughly 13 EH/s of hashing power to the OCEAN mining pool.The attackers didn't earn anything for their trouble. No blocks were mined, and their payout address received no payments.
